preserved: Repeated tiling landmarks remain clipped by the transformed local geometry; the clickable visual descendants remain present; exactly one local link edge resolves to its homologous destination node at the measured page-space position
violated: Any tile landmark crosses the clip, the clip or transform is omitted/applied twice, visual or clickable descendants disappear, or the link edge is pending, captured, duplicated or points to a non-homologous node
unknown: Nonfinite/unrepresentable clip or tiling geometry, missing destination position, or a destination outside the page-local registry makes only the dependent observation Unknown; it must not authorize a synthetic edge, node, route or preservation claim
executable_semantic_witness: Build the directed graph of local references and definitions; require every edge resolves once, rasterize landmarks in page space, require repeated red/blue tile order only inside the transformed clip, and hit-test the preserved link region against the destination node
mechanics_excluded: Exact SVG bytes; concrete ID names; XML attribute spelling; defs order; equivalent transform factorization

preserved: Gradient landmarks and alpha, the asymmetric image orientation, resolved image box and cover intersection are all visible together without one family changing another's spatial basis
violated: Fill/stroke are exchanged, alpha is lost, orientation is ignored or doubled, MIME/content is incoherent, fit is recomputed, or cover pixels leak/disappear inside the intended intersection
unknown: Unsupported paint, ambiguous image kind, missing orientation carrier, nonfinite box/clip, unavailable decoder or unobservable alpha remains Unknown for that observation and never becomes Preserved by omission
executable_semantic_witness: Rasterize over transparent background; sample distinct gradient stops and alpha, asymmetric oriented image corners and inside/outside cover points; verify the image resource resolves under its coherent media kind and all samples occupy the resolved page-space bounds
mechanics_excluded: Base64 text; encoded raster bytes; compression; data-URL spelling; paint-server names; defs order

preserved: The glyph outline from the pipeline-resolved complete FontKey, its fill/alpha and one Y inversion occupy the intended transformed position; the enclosing link edge resolves to the measured local destination while retaining its clickable descendants
violated: An incidental font or same glyph_id from another face is selected, base_char/tofu substitutes the outline, scale/Y/ancestor transform is omitted or doubled, alpha changes, or the link graph becomes pending/captured
unknown: Absent/conflicting request mapping, missing face/outline, zero units_per_em, nonfinite transform or absent destination remains Unknown and emits neither fabricated glyph/text nor invented link target
executable_semantic_witness: Compare contour landmarks against the resolved face, page-space bounds under noncommuting transforms, fill RGBA and link hit region; require one closed edge-to-node relation and stable result when the font collection is reversed
mechanics_excluded: Path command spelling; defs/use choice; glyph and destination ID names; font collection index; defs order

preserved: Nested red/blue/alpha SVG landmarks survive as one image resource while repeated tiling morphology and complex stroke width/caps/joins/dashes remain visible in their declared geometry
violated: Embedded shape or alpha is lost, the image escapes its box, tiling phase/pitch changes, stroke is simplified or exchanged with fill, or a cross-family ID captures the wrong definition
unknown: Compressed, externally dependent or ambiguous SVG root; unsupported tiling body; or unrepresentable stroke/geometry remains Unknown only for its dependent claim, with explicit fallback where required
executable_semantic_witness: Decode and rasterize the embedded SVG independently and in the composed page; sample red, blue and translucent overlap; measure at least two tiling repetitions and stroke landmarks for width/cap/join/dash; require every image/pattern/paint reference resolve to the intended kind
mechanics_excluded: Nested SVG source bytes; base64; concrete resource names; equivalent path segmentation; defs order

preserved: On each page, same-page links resolve only to homologous local nodes; the clipped raster landmark remains visible; a cross-page target without an explicit route preserves visual/link descendants but has no pending fragment
violated: A same-page edge is missing or targets the other page, IDs collide across page-local graphs, a cross-page fragment/position/route is fabricated, visual descendants disappear, or the image ignores its clip
unknown: The cross-page edge without caller-owned route is canonically Unknown; missing/nonfinite local position, ambiguous image format or invalid clip is also Unknown and cannot be promoted by another family's success
executable_semantic_witness: Construct a separate reference graph per page; require all same-page edges closed locally, no cross-page edge in either graph, explicit Unknown classification for the cross-page carrier, and raster samples visible only inside the page-space clip
mechanics_excluded: Whether page-local IDs repeat across separate SVG documents; filename/URI spelling when an explicit route is absent; bytes; defs order

preserved: Five deliberately colliding source labels remain five semantically typed definitions or otherwise unambiguously separated identities; each use edge reaches the intended glyph, paint, pattern, clip or destination and the composed visible morphology is unchanged under alpha-renaming
violated: Any edge is captured by another definition kind, any definition is orphaned/pending/duplicated incompatibly, visible glyph/paint/tiling/clip/link morphology changes, or collision handling depends on encounter order
unknown: An opaque or unsupported definition remains Unknown only if no false edge or visible substitution is created; ambiguity in any required edge prevents whole-corpus Preserved
executable_semantic_witness: Parse all local href/url/clip-path edges into a typed multigraph; require one existing compatible target per edge, no incompatible cross-kind capture, expected visible landmarks and alpha, then alpha-rename all IDs and reverse defs order and require the same canonical typed graph and raster witness
mechanics_excluded: Concrete ID strings; namespace prefixes; hash/dedup algorithm; defs order; XML bytes

preserved: Preserved observations may coexist with explicitly Unknown observations only when the verdict vector retains each component and no aggregate success hides opacity
violated: Unknown is converted to Preserved, silently omitted from the verdict vector, used to fabricate content/reference/route, or forgiven because three other families pass
unknown: Ambiguous, opaque, unsupported, missing-carrier, externally dependent or nonfinite constructions are canonically Unknown; Unknown never enters a positive count or mutation success
executable_semantic_witness: Emit a verdict vector keyed by corpus and observable with values Preserved/Violated/Unknown; require every declared opaque component equal Unknown in direct, repeated and reordered runs
mechanics_excluded: Formatting and ordering of the verdict vector after canonical key sorting

preserved: Every local edge used for glyph, paint, pattern, clip, image or destination resolves to exactly one compatible definition/node; alpha-renaming and defs reordering preserve typed graph isomorphism
violated: Pending edge, orphan required node, incompatible cross-kind capture, accidental alias, non-equivalent deduplication or encounter-order-dependent resolution
unknown: An intentionally absent edge for a declared Unknown fallback remains Unknown and must not be inserted into the preserved graph
executable_semantic_witness: Canonicalize nodes by semantic kind plus observable payload and edges by owner/use role; compare graph isomorphism before and after bijective ID renaming and reverse defs order
mechanics_excluded: Concrete names, generated prefixes, node serialization order and defs placement

preserved: Final page-space bounds, noncommuting transform composition, clips, visible landmarks and alpha match each corpus contract across all interacting families
violated: Any family changes another family's basis, transform occurs zero/twice, clip uses wrong space, content disappears/substitutes, or alpha/fill/stroke differs visibly
unknown: Nonfinite or unrepresentable geometry and unavailable rendering evidence remain Unknown rather than inferred from XML presence
executable_semantic_witness: Render over transparent background at fixed scale; compare declared landmark regions, bounds and RGBA tolerances plus typed graph witness; XML presence alone is insufficient
mechanics_excluded: Equivalent path decomposition, matrix spelling, antialiasing inside declared tolerance and renderer-internal algorithms

preserved: Two fresh complete executions and a run with corpus/font/defs traversal orders reversed yield identical canonical semantic graph, geometry, landmark RGBA and verdict vector
violated: Any semantic observation, typed edge, page-space geometry, alpha or verdict depends on execution or traversal order
unknown: Every predeclared Unknown remains Unknown in all runs; instability never downgrades a contradiction to Unknown
executable_semantic_witness: Serialize canonical tuples sorted by corpus, observable and typed graph key; SHA-256 them; require run1=run2=reordered while separately requiring all positive and opaque expectations
mechanics_excluded: Whole SVG byte identity is neither required nor sufficient; ID names, defs order, attribute order and base64 are excluded
